description: A letter with no 'Due dates' header still has an action deadline mid-body. The whole letter is scanned, so it must be found and the 'no due-date section' unknown must not appear.

input.text:
FERN COUNTY DEPARTMENT OF HUMAN SERVICES
DATE: 02/01/2027
It is time to renew your benefits.
The benefits you need to renew have a check-mark next to them:
[x] SNAP
Please return your renewal by March 3, 2027.
If we do not hear from you, your benefits might end on 04/01/2027.
Items we need from you: send copies.
• Proof of income: last 4 pay stubs.
